name: Mind Nexus
summary:
Mind Nexus is a spatial idea board for Meta Quest. Brainstorm, research, plan and study on large boards that float in your room or in a calm cloud world.

BUILD YOUR BOARD
• Notes with rich formatting, links, images, tables, lists and charts that update from your tables
• Connect ideas with labeled arrows, focus on one branch, and star the nodes that matter
• Switch to 3D view: your nodes become bubbles, charts and cards placed around you

THINK WITH AI
• Ask AI: write a question and the notes connected to
